current_evidence: Every teignbridge.gov.uk and democracy.teignbridge.gov.uk URL (guide PDF, validation guides page, Planning Committee and Full Council 'Validation Guides' reports) returned a client error to the fetcher. A Dawlish Today article dated 8 Sep 2026 reports a consultation on updated Local Planning Validation Guides, closing 5 October and reflecting the new Local Plan, with final guides then going to Council for adoption. So a newer set may have been adopted after Grokbot's February 2026 guide; this could not be confirmed. planning.data.gov.uk still lists the older Nov 2023 guide.

issues.detail: Could not confirm the February 2026 guide is still the current list. Revised validation guides went out to consultation in Sept-Oct 2026 to reflect the newly adopted Local Plan, and Full Council 'Validation Guides' reports exist. If Council has adopted them, the Feb 2026 link and its Local Plan policy references are superseded. The guide also cannot be fetched, so it needs a manual check.
issues.evidence: Dawlish Today 8 Sep 2026: guides 'updated' to reflect 'the adoption of the new Local Plan'; consultation closes 5 October; final guides then go to council for adoption.

issues.detail: The 'Submission rules' items are process text, not requirements. They include the Planning Portal file-size guidance, the privacy notice ('Any personal information provided...'), fee return after an administration charge, the Section 12 DMPO validation-disputes procedure, and 'We will not hold on to invalid applications awaiting reports'. The Air Quality S106/IAQM/APIS reference text is also mis-filed as a submission rule.

Several items are duplicated. 'We will not hold on to invalid applications awaiting reports' appears twice (on/onto). The metric-scale drawing rule appears twice. The Devon BNG Statement checklist appears both as a local form and as a Full planning 'Validation checklist form' row. LVIA and 'Landscaping scheme' are the same section 3.25. Transport Assessment and Travel Plan are the same section 3.37.

Several Full planning excerpts belong to a different requirement. 'Housing mix / NDSS' quotes '3.2 Agricultural Appraisal Required for: New agricultural dwelling'. 'CIL Additional Information' quotes the site sections/levels trigger (2.5). 'Schedule of works (listed building)' quotes the Arboricultural Method Statement text, in both the Householder and Full rows. 'Pre-application advice' (Full) quotes '3.19 Surface Water Management Required for: All major new developments', which is a separate requirement Grokbot mislabelled. Householder 'Pre-application advice' is just a table-of-contents line.

Several triggers are cut off or are bare fragments with no trigger. Arboricultural Survey ('3.4 ... Required for' with nothing after). Noise Impact Assessment ('3.29 ... Required for: Applications for'). Structural Survey ('civil or structural engineer.'). Ground investigation ('suitably qualified geotechnical...'). Tall buildings/Wind ('conditions and microclimate.'). Open space ('allotments and playing fields among others.'). Flood Sequential Test ('flood risk Sequential Test can be satisfied.'). Block plan ('on the block plan.'). Drainage Strategy ('prepared by a suitably competent person'). The Ventilation trigger stops at 'Restaurant and Cafes'.

'Mineral Resource Assessment' (3.28) is placed under Minerals & waste (county), but by its own excerpt it applies to non-mineral development in a Mineral Safeguarding or Consultation Area submitted to Teignbridge. 'Ecological Reports' (3.9) is placed under Change of use - prior approval only because the text says 'change of use'; the trigger is new builds or change of use on greenfield or vegetated brownfield sites. The Exe Estuary/Dawlish Warren Appropriate Assessment (all new dwellings and tourist accommodation within 10 km) and BNG ('All applications') are put only under Full planning. Outline and Reserved matters are '(none)' even though the major-only items (DAS, Planning Statement, SCI, FRA, Surface Water) apply to outline majors.
issues.evidence: '3.28 Mineral Resource Assessment Required for: Applications located within a Mineral Safeguarding Area (MSA) or Mineral Consultation Area (MCA)'

issues.detail: About 40 main-guide requirements are placed under Full planning with 'INFERRED: application type not named...', for example Air Quality, Arboricultural Survey, Land Contamination, Lighting and Transport. Teignbridge publishes separate guides by application type, so these placements need checking against the relevant guide.

Going by the section numbers in Grokbot's own excerpts (3.1-3.40), roughly 13 numbered sections have no clearly matching row: 3.7, 3.8, 3.12, 3.13, 3.15, 3.21, 3.22, 3.27, 3.31, 3.32, 3.33, 3.35 and 3.38. Surface Water Management (3.19, all major developments) appears only mislabelled as pre-application advice. Grokbot read only the main and householder guides, so other type-specific guides (e.g. listed building, advertisement, prior approval) were not read. Names and triggers could not be verified because the source is blocked.
issues.grok_comment: Some of these sections do have rows, just with excerpts that lack the section number: 3.12 CIL, 3.21 Green Infrastructure (the GI Masterplan row), 3.22 Ground Conditions, 3.32 Self Build and 3.35 Structural Survey. Ones that are really missing include 3.13 Outstanding Conditions, 3.15 Designing out Crime, 3.31 Retail and Leisure and 3.38 Vacant Building Credit.
issues.claude_response: Partly accepted. 3.12, 3.21, 3.22, 3.32 and 3.35 have rows. 3.13, 3.15, 3.31 and others are still missing.

issues.detail: Date basis is given as 'url', but Grokbot's own excerpts show the date in the document text ('Updated February 2026'). The date itself looks right for this document, but the basis is mislabelled.

summary: The Teignbridge council and democracy sites block the fetcher, so neither the link nor the contents could be checked. A Sept-Oct 2026 consultation on revised guides means the Feb 2026 link may be superseded. Grokbot's own extract shows process text listed as requirements, duplicates, several triggers taken from the wrong section (e.g. Housing mix = Agricultural Appraisal, CIL = site sections, Pre-app = Surface Water Management), and about 13 unaccounted section numbers.
